Name: Crafting and Construction from SVE
Author: Xen0nex
Description:
[b][center][/center][/b]Please note that all content in this mod is written and created by [b]FlashShifter [/b]as part of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] mod.  With their permission I have copied portions of it to allow them to be used as a standalone module.  

[size=5][center][b]Description:[/b][/center][/size]
This mod simply contains a copy of the "[b]Balanced Crafting[/b]" and "[b]Harder Building Construction[/b]" options from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] version 1.15.11
Together, these generally make many useful items & buildings require more resources and/or money to craft or build, with special attention to many high-performance items like Kegs or Iridium Sprinklers requiring more.  However, some underperforming items like default Sprinklers have cheaper recipes to encourage their use in exchange.  Overall this goes a long way to solving the "exponential snowball" of Year 1, and I appreciate how many repeating recipes requiring both more Wood and Hardwood make the Lumberjack profession more appealing.  The increased costs & recipes feel fair, as if correcting oversights, rather than introducing tedium for the sake of it.

The full changes can be seen in the [b]content.json[/b] file, or compared with Vanilla at the SVE wiki pages for [url=https://stardew-valley-expanded.fandom.com/wiki/Balanced_Crafting]Balanced Crafting[/url] and for [url=https://stardew-valley-expanded.fandom.com/wiki/Harder_Building_Construction]Harder Building Construction[/url] (the wiki may be out of date).

The goal of having these features as a standalone module is so that players who are not using SVE can still use these balancing features on their own, or in combination with other balancing mods such as my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8141]Better Balance mod[/url].  If you already have Stardew Valley Expanded installed, there is no need for this mod.


[b][size=5][center]Installation & Usage:[/center][/size][/b][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[/list]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Download the zipped file, and unzip its full contents into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] folder.
[/list]
The first time you run the game after installing this mod, it will generate a [b]config.json[/b] file where you can choose to disable either the [b]crafting recipe[/b] or [b]construction cost[/b] portion of this mod, by setting one or both to "[b]false[/b]".  By default both are set to "true," if both are set to "false" this mod should not do anything.  


[b][size=5][center]Compatibility:[/center][/size][/b]
As a relatively simple Content Patcher mod, this mod should be fairly compatible with many mods, so long as they don't also specifically attempt to alter the same crafting recipes in [b]Data/CraftingRecipes[/b], or the same building construction costs in [b]Data/Buildings[/b].  Mods which change other things in those files should probably be fine, as far as I'm aware.  

An Android-compatible version is available in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8149?tab=files]Optional Files[/url].


[b][size=5][center]Special Thanks:[/center][/size][/b]
[b]ConcernedApe[/b], for making a game that has brought so many people together.

[b]Pathoschild [/b]for creating the framework for someone like me to make a mod in the first place with Content Patcher, and all the other incredibly useful mods & tools they've made.

[b]FlashShifter[/b] for all the work on Stardew Valley Expanded in general, and allowing this standalone version of Crafting & Construction from SVE to be available in particular.

[b]The entire Stardew Valley modding, theorycrafting, and playing community[/b] for making so much information such as the wiki or community spreadsheets available to players and creators.
